title: Online member registration & login
description:
The system shall allow students and staff to register an online account
 linked to their university ID/email and log in securely via web browser.
acceptance_criteria: User can register with a valid university email/ID and successfully log in; a secure session is established.

title: Online catalogue search
description:
The system shall allow any authenticated or guest user to search
 the book catalogue by title, author, ISBN, subject or year via 
the web interface.
rationale: Core discovery function for online users.
acceptance_criteria: Search returns relevant results with availability status within the target response time.

title: Online digital access request
description: The system shall allow a logged-in member to request digital access (loan) for an available book online. The system shall record the request and make it available for the Admin to review and approve or reject.
rationale: Enables self-service digital borrowing with administrative control.
acceptance_criteria: A member can submit an access request; the system records its status as Pending Approval; an Admin can approve or reject it, and the member can see the updated status.

title: Digital Copyright Violation and Fine Management
description: The system shall record and manage suspected copyright violations involving digital books, including unauthorized copying, downloading, sharing, redistribution, and attempts to bypass copyright protection mechanisms. An authorized Admin shall review reported violations and confirm whether a violation has occurred before issuing a fine. The fine amount shall be determined by the confirmed severity level: Level 1 — 10,000 VND, Level 2 — 20,000 VND, and Level 3 — 50,000 VND. The system shall record the violation details, confirmed severity level, fine amount, and payment status, and allow the affected User to view the fine and make a simulated payment
rationale: Supports copyright protection for digital books, ensures that reported violations are reviewed before penalties are imposed, and provides transparent, consistent fine management.
acceptance_criteria: The system records suspected copyright violations involving unauthorized copying, downloading, sharing, redistribution, or attempts to bypass copyright protection mechanisms. An authorized Admin can review a reported violation and confirm or reject it. A fine is issued only after the Admin confirms a violation. The fine amount matches the confirmed severity level: Level 1 — 10,000 VND, Level 2 — 20,000 VND, and Level 3 — 50,000 VND. The system records the fine and payment status, allows the affected User to view the fine, and supports simulated payment. Digital loan expiry and reading access revocation are verified separately against REQ-12.

title: Audit log for authentication and administrative security actions
description: The system shall record authentication and administrative security events, including successful and failed login attempts, digital access request decisions, loan renewals, and the application or removal of account sanctions. Each record shall include the actor or system source, timestamp, event type, target account or request where applicable, outcome, and relevant details.
rationale: Supports accountability for authentication, access decisions, and administrative security actions.
acceptance_criteria: Each tested authentication, access-request decision, renewal, and sanction action has a corresponding accurate audit record with actor system source, timestamp, event type, outcome, and relevant details; unauthorized Users cannot view audit records.

title: Role-based access control (Web)
description: The system shall enforce role-based access control so that Users and Admins can only view and perform actions permitted for their roles.
rationale: Essential security requirement for a web system with User and Admin roles.
acceptance_criteria: A User account cannot access Admin-only pages or functions; an Admin can access authorized administration functions.

title: Online loan renewal
description: The system shall allow eligible members to renew their digital loans online (subject to reservation queue and maximum renewal limit).
rationale: Reduces need to visit the library for simple renewals.
acceptance_criteria: Member can renew an eligible loan; new due date is updated and confirmed.

title: Online loan history & fine view
description: The system shall allow a logged-in member to view current digital loans, borrowing history, due dates and outstanding fines through the web portal.
rationale: Provides transparency and reduces routine enquiries.
acceptance_criteria: Member can view current loans, past loans and outstanding fines with accurate status and dates.

title: Add books to favourites list
description: The system shall allow a logged-in User to add or remove books from a personal favourites list and view that list later.
rationale: Helps Users save and quickly find books of interest.
acceptance_criteria: A User can add a book to favourites, see it in their list, and remove it from the list.

title: Read books online
description: The system shall allow a User with valid digital access to read the selected book online through the web interface.
rationale: Provides the core digital reading experience.
acceptance_criteria: A User with approved, unexpired access can open and read the book online; a User without valid access is denied.

title: Request to borrow a book again
description: The system shall allow a logged-in User to submit a new digital access request for a book they have borrowed previously, subject to availability and account restrictions.
rationale: Supports repeat use of learning and research materials.
acceptance_criteria: A User can request access again; the system checks availability and account restrictions and displays the request status.

title: Automatically revoke reading access at expiry
description: The system shall verify digital loan expiry whenever a User attempts to access a digital book. If the loan has expired, the system shall revoke the active reading permission, record the expiry event, and deny further access.
rationale: Ensures digital access follows the approved loan period and licensing rules.
acceptance_criteria: At the approved loan expiry time, the User can no longer open or continue accessing the book. The system records the expired access status without requiring the User to reopen the book or an Admin to take manual action.

title: Manage account violations and sanctions
description: The system shall apply sanctions according to the library rules configured by an authorized administrator.
rationale: Enables consistent enforcement of library policies and controlled reinstatement of accounts.
acceptance_criteria: The Admin receives an alert for a configured violation condition, can review it and apply or remove account restrictions; each action, reason and timestamp is recorded.

title: Loan Expiration Notification and Automatic Reading Access Revocatio
description: The system shall notify the User one day before the loan period expires. When the loan period expires, the system shall automatically revoke the User's reading access to the corresponding digital book. After access is revoked, the User shall not be able to open or continue reading the book unless the User submits a new borrowing request and the request is approved. The system shall not send overdue notifications.
rationale: Keeps Users informed when reserved books become available and ensures that reading access is automatically revoked when the loan period expires.
acceptance_criteria: 1. The next eligible User receives a notification when a reserved digital copy becomes available. 2. The system automatically revokes the User's reading access to the corresponding digital book when the loan period expires. 3. No overdue notification is sent when a loan becomes overdue. 4. No unrelated User is notified.

title: Secure input validation against injection attack
description: The system shall validate and safely process User-provided input to prevent SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS). Input shall not be executed as SQL commands or browser scripts.
rationale: Protects application data and Users from malicious inpu
acceptance_criteria: SQL injection test input does not cause unauthorized data changes; XSS test input does not execute scripts in the browser.

title: Audit log for reservation, return, and fine transactions
description: The system shall record circulation and financial transactions, including placing or cancelling a digital reservation, processing a return or closing a loan, and creating or adjusting a fine. Each record shall include the actor or system source, timestamp, transaction type, related book/loan/reservation/member, and relevant transaction details.
rationale: Provides traceability for circulation and fine transactions and supports dispute resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Every tested reservation, reservation cancellation, return/loan closure, and fine creation or adjustment has a corresponding accurate audit record containing the actor/system source, timestamp, transaction type, related record, and relevant details; no performed transaction is missing.

title: Approval of digital access requests by Admin
description: The system shall allow an authenticated Admin to approve or reject a valid pending digital access request. Upon approval, the system shall update the request status and grant online reading access according to the borrowing rules. The decision shall be recorded.
rationale: Ensures digital borrowing requests are reviewed and approved by an authorized administrator.
acceptance_criteria: The Admin can approve a valid pending request; its status changes to Approved; the User can read the book according to the access rules; and the decision is recorded.
